content: Commercial CAD cleanup centers on: PURGE (remove unused blocks/layers/linetypes, -PURGE adds Regapps option), third-party Drawing Purge tools with DWG-PURGE-BATCH for scripted mass cleanup across Xrefs, Autodesk's standalone Drawing Cleanup Utility (detailed purge + Excel audit report, needs AutoCAD 2024+), and layer isolation/freeze workflows. Civil-specific tools (CTC CIM Suite) add Corridor Cleanup, Label Genie for repeatable production cleanup at scale.
